name: Goddesscore
summary: Goddesscore is an aesthetic inspired by the divine goddesses of mythology, and centers around mainly gold as opposed to silver jewelry, ancient-inspired fashion styles, divine beauty, and feminine power.
description: Goddesscore is an aesthetic inspired by the divine goddesses of mythology, and centers around mainly gold as opposed to silver jewelry, ancient-inspired fashion styles, divine beauty, and feminine power. While heavily associated with Hellenic and Greco-Roman aesthetics, it also incorporates visual influences from Egyptian, Hindu, Celtic, and other cultural depictions of the divine feminine. It emphasizes gold jewelry, flowing garments, celestial motifs, divine femininity, and the embodiment of ethereal beauty and power.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Femininity, divinity, beauty, empowerment, grace, spirituality

visualDNA.colour: Gold, white, cream, blush, pearl, soft pastels

fashion.Clothing: Flowing maxi dresses; White, cream, or pastel drapery; Toga-style wraps; Silk, chiffon, linen; Gold-embroidered fabrics; Capelets, veils, shawls; Barefoot or lace-up sandals
fashion.Accessories: Gold jewelry; Arm cuffs; Laurel wreaths; Circlets; Shell or pearl adornments; Sun and moon pendants; Layered necklaces and bangles
fashion.Hair & Makeup: Soft curls or updos; Braids with ribbons or gold thread; Dewy makeup and highlighter; Gold eyeliner; Glossy lips; Shimmering body oil
